description: This file defines a ViewModel class for the settings screen in an Android application. It manages the UI-related data such as the title and counter, interfacing with a repository to initialize data and providing a method to increment the counter.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for managing settings screen data, including title and counter, with functionality to increment the counter.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the counter value stored in LiveData by 1.
